title: Prism Optimized
description: Prism Optimized boosts Minecraft FPS on low-to-high-end PCs. This particular modpack has unique configurations to improve the performance of Minecraft!
body:
## Introducing Prism Optimized
Prism Optimized is a Fabric modpack for **Minecraft**, built for one purpose — to make the game run the way it should. Whether you're on a budget laptop or a high-end rig, Prism delivers a smoother, more responsive experience without stripping away what makes Minecraft feel like Minecraft.


![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a0eb0b49e21b58f643bb9f8496246e721ed1020.png)

### Performance & Stability
At its core, Prism is built around a carefully selected set of optimization mods, all configured to work together rather than against each other. From chunk loading to entity rendering, every system has been tuned to reduce stutters, lower memory usage, and push frame rates as high as your hardware allows.

### Versions Supported

![Supported versions](https://tschipcraft.ddns.net/mod_resources/supported/supported.php?not_updated_versions=&untested_versions=,1.21&supported_versions=1.20.1,1.21.11&total_versions=1.16,1.17,1.18,1.19,1.20,1.21,1.20.1,1.21.11&icons=true&white_mode=false&platform=modrinth)

### OptiFine Feature Support
Leaving OptiFine behind doesn't mean leaving your resource packs behind. Prism includes ETF (Entity Texture Features), EMF (Entity Model Features), and Continuity, covering the vast majority of OptiFine-dependent features—including custom entity textures, model overrides, and connected textures. For most packs, you can drop them straight in, and they'll just work.

### Shader Support
Prism ships with Iris, bringing full shader support to Fabric. Whether you want to play vanilla or completely transform the look of the game with shaders, both are supported out of the box.
